plan: A little mage who blows up a target in a second and stuns a whole area with her bear Tibbers.
aSurveiller: Her passive stun (Pyromania). Every 4 spells, the next one stuns: when an aura glows around her, stay out of her range.
contrer: Watch her stun counter: when it's ready, keep your distance.
Engage her right after she has used her stun: she is fragile.
Spread out when she has her R: Tibbers can stun a whole area at once.
faiblesses: Predictable: you can see when her stun is ready.

sorts.P: Every 4 spells, the next one stuns.
sorts.E: Shield and speed for her or an ally.
sorts.R: Summons Tibbers, who damages the area and burns nearby enemies.

momentFort: Very dangerous from level 6 with Tibbers.
